_note: QA of the SECOND (strengthened-prompt) regeneration wave: the 48 tiles that failed the first pass. Every one of the 48 new files was opened at full size (1024x1024) with read_image and judged on R1 genre, R2 skin palette/medium, R3 craft (no readable text/brand/numerals/pseudo-words, not blank), R4 no-cliche. Verdict basis is the persistence of the specific defect that caused the first-pass reject, so a tile is PASS only if that defect is gone and no new R1-R4 defect is present. Change check: all 48 new files exist, all 48 md5 differ from their _rejected original, and the coarse 16x16 pixel difference ranges 9.69-51.27, so nothing was re-shipped unchanged. Rejected originals were additionally opened at full size for the R3-lettering cases to distinguish 'lettering removed' from 'lettering merely changed' (20 opened: comic/electro; soviet afro-house, black-metal, ambient-techno, death-metal, microhouse, k-pop, j-pop, thrash-metal, chicago-blues, big-beat, hardstyle, kawaii-future-bass; sovietYears acid-jazz, hybrid-trap, chicago-blues, amapiano, chicago-house; pixel chicago-blues, amapiano). In every one of those 20 pairs the offending text/object was re-randomised rather than removed, and the reading of the other R3 tiles is corroborated by the quoted strings in regen_verification.json (which described these same files as the then-new tiles) plus the md5/pixdiff change check. Objective palette note: whole-image palette_distance (see _batch_review.measure) is 0.03-0.25 for all 48, far below the 0.60 flag, so the global palette is honoured even on tiles whose R2 fail is a local leak (violet sky, green aurora, cyan neon, pastel clouds, pink floor, huge red plate) - the R2 judgements below are therefore local visual findings, not metric flags.

question_4_judgement.classification: (b) predominantly an intrinsic limitation, with a narrow (a) remainder that requires a structural prompt change rather than more emphatic wording
question_4_judgement.paragraph: The evidence points to model behaviour, not prompt phrasing. The second wave passed 0 of 48, and every defect family came back in the same form. In soviet, 26/26 tiles still contain letterforms, and the newly appended 'ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT OR LETTERING ANYWHERE' ban only re-randomised the glyphs: ARED HOUSE became RATH HOUCE, PNEOVE became MIRRITE, COINS became ROURS, BEAT/BEAST/AND ULTRA became BIENAREEA/RMRIDEGRTRDSS, 8097 became 8000, '8080' became '808' plus '8080'. That is the signature of a model in which a 'stencil plate / nameplate / milled machine face' surface carries lettering as an intrinsic texture prior, so a negative text instruction cannot suppress it - particularly for a sub-region, whereas global instructions are obeyed (whole-image palette distance is 0.03-0.25 on all 48, far under the 0.60 flag, and the soviet vaporwave bust/CRT R2 fix held). The 12 sovietYears R2 tiles behave identically at the element level: every banned colour source (violet street glow, purple clouds, green aurora, pink floor, pastel confetti, fog, green/yellow/red speaker panels, cyan neon) still contributes its canonical colour, because the prompt constrains the base inks but not the semantic object that brings its own colour. The 'harp' rewording is the clearest single result: 'blues harmonica (small rectangular mouth organ, never a concert harp)' failed in all four chicago-blues tiles, and in three of them the model responded by adding a small rectangular harmonica while leaving the large frame harp in place - it satisfies the positive noun but cannot delete the strong prior object. Because the same wording change was already tried once and produced 0/48, further adjective-stacking is not a credible fix; the residual (a) options are structural, not verbal: remove the offending surface or object class from the spec (no plate/panel faces, no machine faces, no sky/floor colour carriers), lock the palette per-region, or post-process/inpaint the text and off-palette regions with a separate model - the model demonstrably can produce clean soviet stencil tiles (3/29 passed the first wave), so the limitation is reliability, not absolute incapacity.
